structured.name: Expose: Advanced Web Research
structured.notes: General web research. Returns a markdown research report; requested CSV/JSON comes in a fenced code block. ~5 min per job (spike 2026-10-30).

data.description:
# Advanced Web Research Agent

Conduct comprehensive web research using AI-powered analysis.

This agent answers open-ended questions by decomposing topics into one or more research steps, exploring the web, gathering sources, synthesizing findings, and returning detailed reports with citations.

**To get optimal results:** Do not just post a keyword, but formulate an actual open-ended question you want answered.

data.placeholder: Example: What are the key factors driving electric vehicle adoption in Europe?
Example: Focus on enterprise solutions, emphasize cost comparisons, include regulatory considerations...
